full_prompt_en: A square folk-art-style painting is divided into six close portrait panels arranged in two rows of three. Each person faces forward against a separate brightly colored background, and narrow dark borders keep the six compartments distinct. In the upper left, a dark-skinned man with a small mustache wears a black brimmed hat, patterned dark coat, and yellow-orange neckwear against vivid orange. At the upper center, a second dark-skinned man with short hair wears an ochre jacket over a striped pale shirt before a blue background. The upper right contains a lighter-skinned man in a black hat with a decorated band, dark coat, and white beard against warm yellow. Along the bottom, two women and one man repeat the frontal arrangement. The left woman has long dark braids, pale cream skin, layered necklaces, and a pink patterned garment set against blue. The middle woman has long brown braided hair, rosy cheeks, and a teal dress with a patterned collar. At the lower right, a man in a dark hat and blue striped jacket wears a small yellow patterned tie over a warm brick-and-teal background. Every face has simple symmetrical features, dark outlined eyes, a straight nose, and restrained expression. Small repeated marks fill the coats, backgrounds, and accessories, while the facial planes remain comparatively smooth and flat. The palette alternates hot orange and yellow with saturated blue and teal, creating contrast across neighboring cells. Light is even and frontal in all six panels, with little cast shadow; changes of skin tone and clothing color carry the differences between figures. The overall composition feels like a vivid, orderly tapestry of individual faces, unified by repeated head-and-shoulder scale, dark contour lines, and densely patterned color.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、近似民间艺术的绘画分为六个紧凑肖像格，排成两行三列。每个人都正面朝向观者，背景颜色各异且鲜明，细深色边界让六格分明。左上，一位深肤色、留小胡子的男子戴黑色有檐帽，穿花纹深外套和黄橙领饰，背景是鲜橙色。上方中央，另一位短发深肤色男子穿赭黄夹克与条纹浅衬衫，背后是蓝色。右上，一位浅肤色男子戴有装饰帽带的黑帽，穿深外套，留白胡须，背景暖黄。下排，两位女子与一位男子重复正面安排。左侧女子有长深色辫子、浅奶油色皮肤、层叠项链和粉色花纹衣服，背后是蓝色。中间女子有长棕色编发、红润双颊与带图案领口的青绿衣裙。右下男子戴深帽，穿蓝色条纹夹克，在暖砖红与青绿背景前系小黄花领带。每张脸都有简明对称的五官、深线勾出的眼、直鼻和克制神情。小型重复笔迹填满外套、背景与配件，面部平面则相对平滑而平坦。色域在炽热橙黄与饱和蓝青绿之间交替，使相邻格产生对比。六格光线均匀正面，几乎没有投影；肤色和衣着颜色的变化承担人物差异。整体构图像鲜明、有序的独立人脸织锦，由重复的头肩尺度、深轮廓线与密集图案色彩统一。
style_prompt_en: The image has a folk-art painted finish with flat color fields, firm dark contours, and small repeated decorative marks. Saturated orange, yellow, cobalt, teal, pink, and brick red alternate across adjacent compartments, while black accents hold the structure together. Similar-sized upright shapes repeat in a strict grid, making small changes in color and pattern easy to compare. Focal interior planes are smoothly filled and lightly modeled; surrounding areas are denser with stripes, dots, and textile-like motifs. Illumination is frontal and even, with little cast shadow and few glossy highlights. The overall effect is direct, rhythmic, and richly patterned, combining a clear modular arrangement with lively hand-worked surface detail.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有民间艺术绘画完成面，平坦色域、坚实深色轮廓与细小重复装饰笔迹并存。饱和橙、黄、钴蓝、青绿、粉和砖红在相邻隔间中交替，黑色重音把结构凝聚起来。相近尺度的直立形状在严格网格里重复，使细小颜色与图案变化易于比较。焦点内部平面填色平滑、塑形轻微；周围区域则密布条纹、点和织物般花纹。照明正面均匀，投影很少，光滑高光也少。整体效果直接、有节奏且图案丰盛，把清楚模块布局与活跃手工表面细节结合。
theme_en: A six-part grid of direct-facing people in vivid patterned color
theme_zh: 六格正面人物组合，色彩鲜明且布满图案
name: Faith Ringgold
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
